cv.audience: Systems, embedded Linux, and LinuxBoot engineers
cv.reason: Respected Go userland for LinuxBoot/initramfs; well-known in embedded systems and kernel tooling communities.

issues.reason: Fix shebang file generation for Plan 9 to include proper magic line.
issues.title: shebang mode is broken on Plan 9

issues.reason: Fix boot command to output consistently between default and manual selection, and remove duplicate logging.
issues.title: `boot` command outputs different information if running default

issues.reason: Simplify MkdirTemp to use default system tempdir instead of hardcoded /tmp.
issues.title: Let MkdirTemp() use the default tempdir rather than specifying in code.

issues.reason: Create reboot as a multi-call alias for shutdown -r to avoid accidental shutdowns.
issues.title: Add reboot cmd (alias for shutdown -r)

issues.reason: Add -o flag to truncate command to interpret SIZE as IO blocks.
issues.title: Add "-o" flag to "truncate" command

issues.reason: Fix TryMount to detect filesystem for bind mounts without -t flag.
issues.title: mount -o bind /proc /mnt/proc does not work

issues.reason: Enable additional golangci-lint linters and fix issues in CI.
issues.title: ci: enforce cleaner coding standards

issues.reason: Debug kexec_file_load exec format error on riscv64 when loading vmlinuz.
issues.title: kexec_file_load error

issues.reason: Log the source filename when writing to /tmp files in debug output.
issues.title: Log filename loaded into `/tmp` rather than random filenames in `/tmp`

issues.reason: Fix cmds/.gitignore to ignore .swp and other non-binary files by adding top-level patterns.
issues.title: cmds/.gitignore shows all non "binary" files

issues.reason: Remove SHA-1 support from shasum command due to cryptographic weakness.
issues.title: Remove sha1 support from shasum

issues.reason: Replace StartShell subprocess with unix.Exec to avoid holding boot resources like loop devices.
issues.title: menu: StartShell.Exec leaves boot cmd running

issues.reason: Fix cp argument validation to use correct working directory; include WorkingDir in stat calls.
issues.title: *cp* ignores working directory when checking argument validity

issues.reason: Add -regex command-line flag to find; leverages existing regex matching code.
issues.title: Support `-regex` flag to `find`

issues.reason: Fix strace to handle large programs by switching ptrace from pids to threads.
issues.title: Bug in u-root strace: Issues Tracing Large Programs

issues.reason: Fix tar path handling to keep paths relative; avoid calling ResolvePath which produces absolute paths.
issues.title: Tar expects paths to be relative to the working dir

issues.reason: Fix predicate application in find argument parsing; ensure correct output matching GNU find behavior.
issues.title: find argument parsing is incorrectly implemented

issues.reason: Add seccomp-bpf support to strace to filter syscalls and improve performance.
issues.title: Implement seccomp-bpf

issues.reason: Standardize verbose/debug flag across boot and localboot commands.
issues.title: Inconsistent command-line verbose logging flags

issues.reason: Improve kexec error messages to clarify what function failed and why, especially on ARM.
issues.title: kexec error feedback misleading / unclear

issues.reason: Fix defaultsh crash with -uinitcmd on console=ttyS0; regression from multi-console output commit bedf418.
issues.title: defaultsh crashes when using -uinitcmd and running on console=ttyS0

issues.reason: Fix build failure when using GO111MODULE=off to import u-root commands.
issues.title: Unable to import any commands

issues.reason: Remove vendor directory and manage all dependencies via Go modules.
issues.title: remove vendor

issues.reason: Deduplicate kernel configs by removing redundant copies between configs/ and CI.
issues.title: deduplicate our configs

issues.reason: Implement argument passing in gosh script execution; populate $0...$n from command args.
issues.title: `gosh` truncates script arguments passed over the command-line

issues.reason: Track tinygo compatibility blockers for cmds/boot/boot.
issues.title: tinygo:  cmds/boot/boot

issues.reason: Implement kernel handover (KHO) support in kexec; involves FDT serialization and new interface.
issues.title: kexec with KHO (kernel handover) support

issues.reason: Implement mdev for automatic /dev management on device hotplug events.
issues.title: New command: mdev

issues.reason: Implement fdisk command for disk partition table management.
issues.title: New command: fdisk

issues.reason: Implement lsblk command to display block device information.
issues.title: New command: lsblk

issues.reason: Implement less pager command with scroll navigation and search capabilities.
issues.title: New command: less

issues.reason: Integrate or implement qemu-guest-agent with virtio-serial and QMP protocol support.
issues.title: Add a qemu-guest-agent

issues.reason: Re-run govulncheck integration and fix any reported vulnerabilities.
issues.title: govulncheck

issues.reason: Evaluate and document module pinning for reproducible builds.
issues.title: Reproducibility of pinned go modules since switch from vendoring for a commit in the future?

issues.reason: Investigate invalid UTF-8 error when executing soft link commands in container.
issues.title: Other soft link commands cannot be executed.

issues.reason: Clarify whether --boot=bb and --boot=gbb are the same option in README.
issues.title: [Question] Has a diference between gbb and bb?

issues.reason: Assess feasibility and value of hardware testing infrastructure for u-root.
issues.title: Hardware QA System - is it useful for u-root?
